description: This file defines the LocalizedDateFormatter class responsible for formatting DateTime objects with localization support for days and months, including translation of day and month names.

classes.name: LocalizedDateFormatter
classes.description: A helper class for formatting DateTime objects into localized date strings, including translating day and month names.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a DateTime object into a string based on the provided format, applying localization for certain tokens.

methods.name: getSearchAndReplaceParams
methods.description: Generates search and replace arrays for tokens within a date format string, caching results for performance.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForShortDays
methods.description: Prepares translation mappings for short day names if the format string contains the short day token.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForLongDays
methods.description: Prepares translation mappings for long day names if the format string contains the long day token.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForShortMonth
methods.description: Prepares translation mappings for short month names if the format string contains the short month token.

methods.name: getSearchReplaceTupleForLongMonth
methods.description: Prepares translation mappings for long month names if the format string contains the long month token.
